Container.Name: mcp-obsidian
Container.Overview: MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that connects Claude.ai to a folder of markdown notes (an Obsidian/SilverBullet vault). Lets Claude list, read, create, edit, move, delete, and search your notes in real time. Pairs with SilverBullet for a self-hosted, browser-based editor + graph view (see the obsidian-garden compose stack).

Config.Name: AppData Path
Config.Description: Where to store persistent config (OAuth secret). Settings are saved here so they survive container updates.

Config.Name: Vault Path
Config.Description: Path to your markdown vault. Point this at the SAME folder SilverBullet uses as its /space so notes are shared between the editor and Claude.

Config.Name: MCP Port
Config.Description: Port the MCP server listens on. Use this port when configuring Claude.ai remote MCP.

Config.Name: MCP Client ID
Config.Description: OAuth client ID used when configuring Claude.ai remote MCP. You can leave this as 'mcp-obsidian'.

Config.Name: MCP Auth Token (Secret)
Config.Description: A secret token to protect your MCP endpoint. Set any long random string (e.g. output of: openssl rand -hex 32) and use the same value when configuring Claude.ai. Leave blank only if you rely entirely on Cloudflare Access Service Auth.

Config.Name: Writable Extensions
Config.Description: Comma-separated file extensions the MCP server may create/edit/delete. Reading is allowed for any file in the vault.
